title: Highest-scoring trainer after coaching about 90 people in agile software development
summary: My last agile software development workshop at Amazon received a feedback score of 4.57 out of 5 and made me the program's highest-scoring trainer that month, after about 90 people across 3 workshops.
the_call: Keep building agile software development skills in other teams alongside my delivery work.
what_i_did: Taught about 90 people across 3 agile software development workshops, plus a product ownership workshop, as a volunteer trainer.
what_changed: Highest-scoring trainer in the monthly program update; a participant wrote that I made the group comfortable to engage and argue back.

metrics.label: people across 3 agile software development workshops

quotes.text: I really liked the way Datta took our questions with all excitement and made us comfortable to freely engage in conversations and counter arguments.
Congratulations on being the highest scoring trainer!!
